selected.licence_evidence: Copyright 2020 The Jost Project Authors (https://github.com/indestructible-type) — OFL text retrieved from the official google/fonts repository and stored beside the binary
selected.commercial_artwork_rights: PERMITTED — OFL allows commercial use, embedding and outlining; outlined artwork is a DOCUMENT, not a Modified Version, so the Reserved Font Name does not attach

previous.why_replaced: rights-cleared but a neutral humanist sans; the reference supporting line is a lighter, more geometric face

compatibility.with_imbue_didone: a geometric sans against a Didone is the conventional luxury-cosmetics pairing — high contrast in construction, shared vertical stress, no competition for attention
compatibility.with_bbrose_logo: the approved mark is a serif wordmark; Jost sits subordinate to both it and Damascena
